summary: FERC's Deputy Secretary sets October 21, 2026 as the deadline for answers to PJM's motion to hold the backstop procurement paper hearing in abeyance.

points.point: Answers to PJM's abeyance motion are due by 5:00 pm Eastern on October 21, 2026.
points.quote: answers to PJM’s motion are due by 5:00 pm Eastern Time on October 21, 2026.

throughLine.text: Sets the answer period on a schedule motion in PJM's separate backstop procurement dockets, which address capacity for new large loads, the subject of the E-7 adequacy report.
